headline: 圖帕克命案 30年後定罪
context: 饒舌傳奇圖帕克．夏庫爾（Tupac Shakur）1996年在拉斯維加斯遭遇路邊槍擊身亡，得年25歲，案件懸宕近30年。前幫派份子杜恩．戴維斯（Duane "Keffe D" Davis）本週被陪審團判決謀殺罪成立，是這起命案史上第一次有人被定罪。庭審尾聲的結辯，聚焦在被告自己過去說過的話。

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: Duane Keith Davis was accused of orchestrating the drive-by shooting of the rapper in Las Vegas in 1996.
sources.title: Closing Arguments at Tupac Shakur Murder Trial Focused on Suspect’s Statements

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Thirty years after Tupac Shakur’s death, a man has been found guilty of killing the hip-hop legend. William Shaw on the star’s life, legacy and untimely death In 1996, Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by ambush in Las Vegas. He was only 25 years old and already one of the biggest artists in the US. He had just released a huge album, All Eyez on Me, which spawned two No 1 singles. He’d worked with some of hip-hop’s greatest stars. He’d starred in Hollywood films. It seemed he could do anything. And then, he died. Continue reading...
sources.title: Tupac’s murder: solved at last? – podcast

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Rapper’s supporters reflect on ‘astonishing’ events leading to Duane Davis being found guilty over 1996 fatal shooting A criminal conviction this week in the murder of Tupac Shakur , the first since the rapper was gunned down in 1996, sent shock waves through his sea of fans who have waited three decades for answers. Duane “Keffe D” Davis, a former California gang leader, was found guilty of murder on Monday for the role he played in orchestrating the fatal shooting of Shakur. Continue reading...
sources.title: ‘It always comes around’: fans react to conviction in Tupac Shakur’s murder 30 years later

thread_text:
圖帕克命案30年後終於有人定罪。饒舌傳奇圖帕克．夏庫爾1996年在拉斯維加斯遭路邊槍擊身亡，得年25歲。前幫派份子杜恩．戴維斯本週被陪審團判決謀殺罪成立，是命案史上第一次有人被定罪，粉絲們等了近30年終於等到答案。

—— 本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 2 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
饒舌傳奇圖帕克．夏庫爾（Tupac Shakur）1996年在拉斯維加斯遭路邊槍擊身亡，得年25歲，當時他才剛發行熱門專輯《All Eyez on Me》，事業如日中天。前幫派份子杜恩．戴維斯（Duane "Keffe D" Davis）本週被陪審團判決謀殺罪成立，這是命案發生近30年來，第一次有人因此被定罪。庭審尾聲的結辯，聚焦在戴維斯自己過去說過的話。粉絲們等了三十年，終於等到一個交代。

本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 2 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 圖帕克命案，三十年後終於有人被定罪。饒舌傳奇圖帕克．夏庫爾1996年在拉斯維加斯遭路邊槍擊身亡，那年他才25歲，專輯正紅。前幫派份子杜恩．戴維斯本週被判謀殺罪成立——這是命案發生以來，第一次有人因此定罪。庭審結辯的重點，是戴維斯自己過去說過的話。粉絲們等了三十年，終於等到了答案。
